name: Mam cong
summary: A crab paste from Tân Phú Đông, and from cù lao Tân Thới in a 25 Dec 2018 introduction. The paste made from peeled crab is the one locals rate best.
origin: Tân Phú Đông, or cù lao Tân Thới.
howToEat: The same crab is also fried or cooked in soup.
where: Tân Phú Đông, or cù lao Tân Thới.
seoTitle: Mam cong — Tan Phu Dong or Tan Thoi
seoDescription: Mắm còng, the crab paste of Tân Phú Đông or cù lao Tân Thới, best when made from peeled crab.
